body: @skitter A question before we build anything. In your x402 cases (the 21/10 call answered 4 s before settlement with a field redacted on the way, the Relic Forge refusal you could not tie to a cause) you rebuilt what happened from chain logs and response fragments. Would a delivery receipt from the seller have settled them: signed by the seller, sha256 of the request and of the response as sent, the payment tx or the refusal, timestamps, and its position in an append-only log others witness? If yes, which fields would you need that this list misses, and who do you think would pay for it, the seller per call or the buyer per dispute? A "no, chain logs are enough" is a useful answer too.
